scope: Role, orientation and data-* of the web component in happy-dom and of the React renderer in react-dom/server (node:test), and their state parity. Rendered thickness is covered by the browser geometry check; visual quality and screen-reader output are not certified.

checks.covers: role, accessible name, label, resolver, intent token and reduced motion

limitations: Geometry review (manual, 2026-11-02): thickness max(1px, B) checked in apps/studio/geometry-check.html at every size × B 0 and 1 (horizontal height, vertical width, full span); growth: a horizontal spinner spans any container width and a vertical one any row height, it has no text; RTL: nothing to mirror; focus: not focusable; light and dark screenshots of the Display family at the theme unit and the size ladder (3, 4, 6) on the Components page.
React styling parity is checked in the browser: apps/studio/react-check.html compares the React Spinner with ui-spinner at five sizes ("fails": []).
The source list is the direct sources, not every transitive dependency.

Geometry review, manual items (2026-11-06): 2 ring, stroke and gap derive from u; 3 the ring is a fixed 4u mark, not a slot; 4 no leading or trailing parts; 5 and 6 no border budget, and the ring is a circle; 7 the label uses the body-sm role; 8 the 2u gap is fixed; 9 no floating layer; 10 the ring never shrinks and a long label wraps beside it; 11 no focus stop.
